input_domain: automatic heading supplement synthesized by the L2 semantic serializer for Value::Content and LocatedContent without a captured field snapshot
rule: Expose heading_supplement_for_lang as the narrow public L1 owner through typst_core::compiler::lang and make the L2 raw-heading fallback construct the existing supplement with heading_supplement_for_lang(None)

public_api.module_policy: the physical heading_supplement module and its table remain private; only the existing helper is publicly reexported
public_api.compatibility: additive public API approved under ADR-0127; existing signatures remain unchanged

obligations: 02_shell calls heading_supplement_for_lang(None) in the Content::Heading raw fallback
None is literal absence of causal language, not an alias for process, document, reference-site, or wrapper language
raw heading JSON, YAML, pretty behavior, key order, field presence, newline, exit, --field, and --one remain byte-identical to the frozen crystalline baseline
LocatedContent with a captured snapshot remains authoritative and bypasses the raw fallback
the 45 ratified owner entries, exact Lang equality, English fallback, purity, and determinism remain unchanged
compiler/lang remains independent of L2 and owns the only heading localization table
preserved: all synthetic raw-heading fields, including supplement text Section
localized causal snapshot fields such as German Abschnitt
warnings, errors, cardinality, and query field selection
forbidden: the literal Section as a productive raw-heading decision in L2
an L2 constant, helper, wrapper, table, locale branch, or Lang inference for the heading supplement
calling the owner with Some English or any invented language instead of None
making the physical owner module public instead of using the narrow hub reexport
removing, adding, reordering, or reinterpreting raw-heading fields
routing snapshot-present LocatedContent through the raw fallback
changing Figure, Equation, format, pretty, --field, --one, warning, error, or newline behavior
promoting Unknown to Preserved or mutation credit
out_of_scope: raw Content parity with vanilla; the ratified vanilla emits a smaller raw heading object
removal of synthetic raw defaults or adoption of vanilla set-field projection
show-set causal language and the pre-show versus rendered phase boundary
support for raw constructor supplement, depth, offset, hanging-indent, or numbering debts
new flags, formats, phases, callbacks, wrappers, or localization tables

oracle_authority.raw_output: frozen crystalline baseline, because P1460 is deliberately output-preserving
oracle_authority.localized_owner_and_snapshot: ratified vanilla pin plus the already-certified P1459 owner corpus
oracle_authority.architectural_ownership: static structural oracle over the protected L0 and productive source
oracle_authority.vanilla_raw_role: scope delimiter and anti-overclaim control, not the expected P1460 output

unknown_policy.rule: Unknown never satisfies a required case, never kills a mutant, and never increases mutation score
unknown_policy.deliberately_opaque_case_unknown: expected classification with zero mutation credit
unknown_policy.none_is_not_unknown: heading_supplement_for_lang(None) is a specified English fallback and must return Section

mutation_gate.invalid_or_unbuildable_mutant: no credit; repair the mutant or classify it inapplicable with evidence
